item.title: KRaft Mode: Running Kafka Without ZooKeeper
item.description: Why ZooKeeper Had to Go For the first decade of Kafka’s existence, every Kafka cluster required an Apache ZooKeeper cluster to manage metadata: controller election, topic configurations, partition leadership, access control lists, and consumer group state.
